claim: In ePIC geometry release 26.11.0 the default far-forward configuration includes two ZDC parts: a LYSO crystal electromagnetic section (ZDC_Crystal_LYSO.xml) and an iron/scintillator SiPM-on-tile hadronic section (ZDC_SiPMonTile.xml)

scope.text: ePIC: ZDC configuration of the released simulation geometry 26.11.0; design-phase, status development

claim: ePIC geometry 26.11.0: the ZDC hadronic section has 64 repeated layers, each of 2 cm Steel235 absorber, 0.40 cm polystyrene scintillator (sensitive), 0.16 cm FR4 PCB, two 0.015 cm ESR-foil slices (modelled as polystyrene) and two 0.1212 cm air gaps, followed by one 2 cm steel back plate

scope.text: ePIC: ZDC hadronic-section layer stack as a design value in the released simulation geometry; status development

limitations: Design value as encoded for simulation (file status 'development', version 1.0); ESR foil modelled as polystyrene; layer thickness 2.8324 cm and total length 183.27 cm are derived here by arithmetic, not stated in the file

claim: ePIC geometry 26.11.0: the ZDC hadronic section envelope is 60 cm wide and 61 cm high with absorber plates 57.6 cm x 58.8 cm; its front face is 35.8 m from the interaction point along an axis rotated by the ion crossing angle, which definitions.xml sets to -0.025 rad
location: compact/far_forward/ZDC_SiPMonTile.xml (width, height, absorber_width, absorber_height, r_pos_front_face, rotateY_angle); compact/definitions.xml (CrossingAngle), tag 26.11.0

scope.text: ePIC: ZDC hadronic-section placement and transverse size as design values in the released simulation geometry

limitations: The 35.8 m is a radial distance along the rotated axis (z = cos(angle) r, x = sin(angle) r per the file); simulation placement, not a survey value

claim: ePIC geometry 26.11.0: the ZDC hadronic-section readout is a staggered Cartesian grid of 48.8 mm x 48.8 mm cells, with 12 rows by 11 columns of tiles in even layers and 11 rows by 11 columns in odd layers; each layer is a separate longitudinal readout layer
location: compact/far_forward/ZDC_SiPMonTile.xml (<readouts>, scintillator_layout constants); src/ZeroDegreeCalorimeterSiPMonTile_geo.cpp (even/odd slice sizes and offsets), tag 26.11.0

scope.text: ePIC: ZDC hadronic-section readout segmentation as a design value in the released simulation geometry

limitations: The per-layer cell counts 132 and 121 and the total 8096 are derived here (rows x columns x 32 layers each), not stated in the file; the staggering semantics of CartesianGridXYStaggered were not read; the even/odd scintillator sheets are offset by +-tile/4 in x in the geometry plugin

claim: ePIC geometry 26.11.0: the ZDC electromagnetic section is an array of LYSO crystals 3 cm x 3 cm in cross-section and 7 cm long over a 60 cm x 60 cm active area, in a 0.3 mm carbon-fibre frame with a 2.5 mm polyethylene photosensor socket, placed at 35.5 m + 5.9 cm + 19.2 cm along the ion-crossing-angle axis, one readout cell per crystal
location: compact/far_forward/ZDC_Crystal_LYSO.xml (<define>, <module>, <readouts>); src/ZDC_Crystal_geo.cpp (nx x ny loop), tag 26.11.0

scope.text: ePIC: ZDC electromagnetic-section crystal layout as a design value in the released simulation geometry

claim: ePIC geometry 26.11.0 defines the ZDC materials as Steel235 (7.85 g/cm3; Fe 0.998, C 0.002 by mass), Polystyrene (1.032 g/cm3, composite C19 H21, Birks constant 0.126 mm/MeV), Fr4 (1.86 g/cm3) and LYSO (7.125 g/cm3; Lu 0.71813, Y 0.03613, Si 0.06338, O 0.18046, Ce 0.00190)
location: compact/materials.xml, entries Steel235, Polystyrene, Fr4, LYSO, tag 26.11.0
